bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
session="$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 81
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 82
test "$(loginctl show-user "$(id -un)" -p Linger --value)" = yes || exit 83
test -f "$session" && test ! -L "$session" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 84
pid_before=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
test -n "$pid_before" && test "$pid_before" != 0 || exit 85
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 86
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" bot_start_menu || exit 87
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 88
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 89
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$pid_before" || exit 90
test -f "$session" && test "$(stat -c %a "$session")" = 600 || exit 91
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_MENU_VERIFIED
echo USERBOT_PROCESS_UNCHANGED
